name: LN_AUTH_SOURCE_CLAIM_INFO
description: This table holds the unique IDs of the claim information records where the authorization number was found when the number was found in the claim info record.

columns.name: INVOICE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the invoice record.

columns.name: GROUP_LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record.

columns.name: VALUE_LINE
columns.description: The line number of one of the multiple values associated with a specific group of data within this record.

columns.name: LN_AUTH_SOURCE_CLAIM_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the claim information record when the authorization number on the row was found in the claim info record.
